# Coinranking

> Coinranking tracks prices, market caps, trading volume and rankings for every cryptocurrency, plus exchanges, DEXs, markets, futures and categories. The data is on coinranking.com and in the Coinranking API (REST, WebSockets and Server-Sent Events).

Prefer the API over scraping the website. Prices change every few seconds, so treat any number as a snapshot and say when it was fetched. Credit the data as "Data from [Coinranking](https://coinranking.com)".

## Agent Quickstart

- Base URL: `https://api.coinranking.com/v2`. HTTPS only.
- Authentication: send the API key in the `x-access-token` header (`Authorization: Bearer <key>` also works). A free key is on https://account.coinranking.com/dashboard/api after signing up.
- Identify coins by UUID, never by symbol or name: symbols are not unique. Bitcoin is `Qwsogvtv82FCd`, Ethereum is `razxDUgYGNAdQ`, and the US dollar is `yhjMzLPhuIDl`.
- To find a UUID, call `GET /search-suggestions?query=<name, symbol or contract address>`. For a token contract on a known chain, `GET /blockchain/:blockchain/:address` returns the coin's UUID. Then pass the UUID to the other endpoints.
- Prices are in US dollars unless you pass `referenceCurrencyUuid` (any coin or fiat UUID; list them with `GET /reference-currencies`).
- Lists use cursor pagination: pass `pagination.nextCursor` from the response as `cursor` until it is `null`. Offset pagination is deprecated and stops at offset 5,000.
- `GET /coins` returns only tier 1 and 2 coins by default. Add `tiers[]=1&tiers[]=2&tiers[]=3` to include every coin.
- A `null` field means unknown, not zero.
- Plans and limits change; read them from [Pricing](https://coinranking.com/api/pricing) and [Rate limits](https://coinranking.com/api/documentation/rate-limit.md) instead of assuming them. Eligible REST endpoints below that need a higher plan can still be tried with five preview requests per endpoint per UTC day; their pages have a Preview access section. Real-time streams have no previews. See [Endpoint previews](https://coinranking.com/api/documentation/endpoint-previews.md).

Which endpoint answers what:

| Question | Endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| Current price of a coin | `GET /coin/:uuid/price` |
| Market cap, supply, all-time high, links of a coin | `GET /coin/:uuid` |
| Top coins, filtered or sorted | `GET /coins` |
| Several known coins at once | `GET /coins?uuids[]=Qwsogvtv82FCd&uuids[]=razxDUgYGNAdQ` |
| Trending coins | `GET /coins/trending` |
| Price history | `GET /coin/:uuid/price-history?timePeriod=30d` |
| OHLCV candles (Growth plan) | `GET /coin/:uuid/ohlcv` |
| Total market cap, 24h volume, Bitcoin dominance | `GET /stats` |
| Exchanges ranked by volume (Growth plan) | `GET /exchanges` |
| Fear and Greed index (Growth plan) | `GET /indicators/fear-and-greed` |
| Live prices pushed to you (Professional plan) | [Real-time](https://coinranking.com/api/documentation/real-time.md): WebSockets or Server-Sent Events |

## Charts

- [ProChart](https://coinranking.com/chart/coin/Qwsogvtv82FCd+bitcoin-btc/price): Interactive charts for any coin, category or the whole market. The whole chart (asset, metric, time range, scale, indicators, comparisons, drawings) is in the URL, so an agent can build a chart as a plain link without an API key. ## API Docs: Real-time

- [Overview](https://coinranking.com/api/documentation/real-time.md): Stream live coin rates, exchange rates, and tickers over WebSockets or Server-Sent Events, and choose the transport that fits your client.
- [WebSockets](https://coinranking.com/api/documentation/real-time/websockets.md): Connect to Coinranking WebSockets to stream live rates, exchange rates, and tickers, and change your subscriptions without reconnecting.
- [Server-Sent Events](https://coinranking.com/api/documentation/real-time/server-sent-events.md): Stream live rates, exchange rates, and tickers over plain HTTP with Server-Sent Events, using the same subscriptions as the WebSocket API.
- [Rates](https://coinranking.com/api/documentation/real-time/rates.md): Stream live aggregated coin prices and 24 hour volumes over WebSockets or Server-Sent Events.
- [Exchange Rates](https://coinranking.com/api/documentation/real-time/exchange-rates.md): Stream live prices and 24 hour volumes of coins on individual exchanges over WebSockets or Server-Sent Events.
- [Tickers](https://coinranking.com/api/documentation/real-time/tickers.md): Stream live ticker updates per market, including price, close, and base and quote volumes, over WebSockets or Server-Sent Events.
